findings.title: persistenceMiddleware ambient localStorage — global override required in tests
findings.why_it_matters: Tests use Object.defineProperty(global, 'localStorage') manipulation instead of clean injection; test isolation is fragile if teardown fails.
findings.what_is_wrong: packages/state/src/persistenceMiddleware.ts:41 calls localStorage.setItem directly with no injection point; tests must override the global.
findings.leverage_impact: Tests work but rely on global override rather than Interface injection.
findings.locality_impact: Adding a storage parameter would be a 3-line change enabling each test to pass a stub directly.
findings.why_weakens_submission: Minor — tests pass and behavior is covered, but the seam is not clean.
findings.minimal_correction_path: Add optional storage?: Storage parameter to persistenceMiddleware factory with localStorage as default.

builder_notes.pattern: Latent type bugs in selectors referencing nonexistent fields
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: A selector returns undefined or null in production for a field that 'should' exist; TypeScript doesn't catch it if the type definition and runtime state diverge silently
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Write a single test for each selector that asserts a non-null/non-undefined value against a constructed state; compile error surfaces the field mismatch
builder_notes.stack_example: selectors.ts:103: state.theme.availableThemes — ThemeState only has selectedThemeId; TypeScript compiled silently because createSelector had implicit any typing

builder_notes.how_to_recognize: A thunk dispatches to two or more slice reducers; test suite covers each slice independently but no test builds a real store and exercises the combined round-trip
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: For each thunk spanning ≥2 slices, one configureStore-based test that dispatches the thunk and asserts getState() across both slices
builder_notes.stack_example: undoRedoThunks.test.ts: captureSnapshot + performUndo tested against a real store instance asserting both state.undoRedo.past and state.tier.tiers

builder_notes.how_to_recognize: Test beforeEach installs a global override; afterEach removes it; tests are order-sensitive if teardown fails
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Add an optional storage?: Storage parameter to the middleware/function under test with localStorage as default; tests pass an in-memory stub directly
builder_notes.stack_example: persistenceMiddleware.ts: adding storage param eliminates all Object.defineProperty in tests

narrative: Good app, place but not win yet. Loop 7 resolves F-003: three new test files cover undoRedoThunks, persistenceMiddleware, and selectors at their public Interfaces (30 new tests, +3 suites). Tests also caught two latent bugs in selectors.ts that would have silently returned wrong values in production — both fixed. Full suite: 20 suites, 114 tests, all green. test_strategy moves 5→7, credibility moves 6→7. Remaining gaps: localStorage injection (workable but not clean) and TierBoardPage.tsx god-component (~757 LOC).
